verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that a compliance officer can configure customer risk factors or inspect why a customer's risk score changed. The closest items are adjacent rather than this capability: workflows that apply policy logic to transactions, the Fraud Signal ML model, marketing claims of a 'single view of fraud risk' and 'real-time risk signals', and Evaluation responses showing vendor service execution status. None of these documents configurable risk factors or a risk-score change explanation.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure customer risk factors and inspect why the risk score changed
